ON EXCEPTION: no cd-name, MESSAGE/SEGMENT or NO DATA phrase'. 2023 drops the Communication module's cd-name RECEIVE. Its RECEIVE is a new message-tag statement with GIVING and ON EXCEPTION, not the 1985 format.
